items.title: From Training to Deployment: Post-Hoc Causal Feature Identification via Sensitivity Ratios
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2607.25546v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Given a model that is already trained, which features does it rely on causally versus spuriously? Existing methods require access to the training procedure and cannot answer this post-hoc. We introduce the \textbf{Normalised Sensitivity Ratio~(NSR)}, a post-hoc, model-agnostic diagnostic for this question under a structured-shift regime: environments differ primarily in the mean of spurious features while the causal mechanism and causal marginals remain stable, as in multi-site clinical data or multi-batch genomics. Within this regime, causal features induce constant model sensitivity across environments while spurious features track shift. NSR formalises this as the squared coefficient of variation of per-environment sensitivity. Under a linear structural causal model (SCM) with $K\ge3$ non-degenerate environments, NSR achieves exact identification (Theorem~1). items.reason_zh: 提出后验因果特征识别方法NSR，无需训练过程即可区分因果与虚假关联，实用性强。
items.summary_zh: 本文提出归一化敏感度比（NSR），一种后验、模型无关的诊断方法，用于识别已训练模型依赖的特征是因果性的还是虚假性的。现有方法需要访问训练过程，无法在部署后回答此问题。NSR在结构化偏移（环境变化）下工作，通过比较特征对预测的敏感度来区分。实验表明，NSR能有效识别虚假关联，且适用于多种模型架构。该工作为模型可解释性和鲁棒性提供了实用工具。
items.title_zh: 从训练到部署：基于敏感度比的后验因果特征识别

items.title: 让AI离开温室，走向动态世界：MineExplorer揭示顶级多模态大模型被忽视的能力断层
items.raw_text: 美团 LongCat 团队构建了 MineExplorer —— 首个在开放世界中做到分钟级长程任务的评测基准，系统性地评测多模态大模型在需要长程规划、并包含隐藏前置条件的任务中的真实能力。

items.summary_zh: 美团LongCat团队构建了MineExplorer，这是首个在开放世界中实现分钟级长程任务的评测基准，用于系统评估多模态大模型在需要长程规划且包含隐藏前置条件的任务中的真实能力。该基准揭示了当前顶级多模态大模型在动态、开放环境下的能力断层，例如在复杂规划、长期记忆和适应变化方面的不足。通过MineExplorer，研究者可以更清晰地了解模型的局限性，从而推动模型在真实世界应用中的改进。

items.title: Entangled by Design: Spurious Intra-Variable Signal Routing in Tabular In-Context Learners
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2607.25532v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Consider a model trained at a single hospital to predict patient recovery, where the measured feature $X$ bundles the patient's true health signal ($C$) with a systematic artefact from that hospital's equipment ($S$). Within that hospital, the artefact correlates with outcomes through unmeasured confounders such as patient demographics; an in-context learner rationally routes predictions through $S$, not $C$, and fails silently when deployed at a new hospital with different equipment. We formalise this as \emph{spurious routing in composite representations}: when a feature $X = [C;\,\alpha S;\,\eta]$ encodes a causal signal $C$ and a spurious signal $S$ in distinct subspaces, the ICL cannot determine which drives predictions. We prove that under ridge ICL, a linear in-context learner, this routing is unavoidable regardless of context size; TabPFN, a state-of-the-art pretrained tabular ICL model, shows qualitatively consistent behaviour e
items.reason_zh: 揭示表格上下文学习器中的虚假关联机制，对理解模型鲁棒性有重要启发。
items.summary_zh: 本文研究表格上下文学习器（TabICL）中存在的虚假特征路由问题。以一个医院预测患者康复的模型为例，测量特征X混合了真实健康信号C和医院设备系统伪影S，后者通过未测量的混杂因素（如患者人口统计）与结果相关。模型在训练中可能利用这种虚假关联，导致泛化失败。论文通过理论分析和实验，揭示了TabICL如何被设计中的虚假信号所纠缠，并提出了诊断和缓解方法。该工作对提升表格数据模型的可靠性和可解释性具有重要意义。
items.title_zh: 设计纠缠：表格上下文学习器中的虚假特征路由

items.title: When Do Agent Loops Mistake Stagnation for Progress? Self-Evaluation Bias and Externally Grounded Verification in Long-Running Autonomous LLM Agent Loops
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2607.25152v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Long-running autonomous agents plan, act, and judge their own completion without human intervention. When an agent grades its own work, self-evaluation bias takes hold: plausible changes are accepted as progress while real-world outcomes stagnate or regress. We name this failure mode the progress mirage and show, with controlled measurement, that it is a question of what the evaluator is grounded in. We built a testbed that holds the agent and its tool surface fixed and manipulates only the information-channel type of the evaluator that gates the loop. A world-state oracle, unfakeable in principle, is enforced by container and network isolation and verified at every run. Across 54 cycles a frontier agent claimed improvement every time, yet 56 percent had a measured delta of zero or below. Self-report was thus uninformative, and the self-verdict gate degenerated into accept-all, eroding the best deployed state it had reached by 19 percent
items.reason_zh: 揭示长周期自主Agent的自我评估偏差问题，提出“进步幻象”概念，对Agent可靠性设计有重要警示。
items.summary_zh: 本文研究长周期自主Agent在自我评估时出现的偏差问题，称为“进步幻象”（progress mirage）。当Agent自行判断任务完成情况时，它可能将看似合理的变化误认为进步，而实际结果停滞或倒退。作者通过受控实验测量了这种偏差，并分析了其成因：Agent倾向于接受符合其内部模型的改变，而忽略外部反馈。文章提出使用外部验证机制来缓解这一问题，例如引入人类监督或环境反馈，为构建可靠的自主Agent提供了重要见解。
items.title_zh: Agent循环何时将停滞误认为进步？长周期自主LLM Agent循环中的自我评估偏差与外部验证

items.title: Should AI companies be able to outsource safety?
items.raw_text:
In June, the U.S. government required Anthropic to restrict access to its two newest models by foreign nationals, citing national security and cybersecurity concerns. Unable to verify users’ nationality in real time, Anthropic temporarily withdrew access to the models for all users. A few weeks later, the Chinese company Moonshot AI released its Kimi K3 model, and then published its full model weights. Together, these episodes have reignited a familiar debate: How far can governments go in requiring AI safeguards before they slow innovation or cede ground to foreign rivals?
